title: Five Nights at Freddy's
summary: A night guard at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza survives five nights against animatronics, with phone calls and hidden screens hinting at earlier killings and missing children.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
summary: A night guard at a new Freddy Fazbear's Pizza location with old and new animatronics, whose minigames depict a purple figure's crimes and the children's fate.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's 3
summary: A guard at the horror attraction Fazbear's Fright faces a single surviving animatronic, while minigames show the pizzeria's dismantling and the killer's fate.
settingYearLabel: Undated in-game (Scott's official description: thirty years after Freddy Fazbear's Pizza closed)

title: Five Nights at Freddy's 4
summary: A child defends a bedroom against nightmare animatronics while between-night minigames follow a crying boy leading up to his birthday, ending with a locked box.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's 4: Halloween Edition
summary: A seasonal alternate edition of FNaF4 with reskinned characters, which Scott declared non-canon.

title: FNaF World
summary: A comedic fantasy RPG starring 'adventure' versions of the characters, whose endings and hidden areas include occasional references to the main series.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Sister Location
summary: A technician works nights beneath Circus Baby's Entertainment and Rental, a facility for animatronics from the closed Circus Baby's Pizza World.

title: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator
summary: A pizzeria-management game that lures salvaged animatronics into a new restaurant, whose tapes and ending speech describe a deliberate plan to destroy them.

title: Ultimate Custom Night
summary: A custom-night game with 50 selectable characters whose unlockable cutscenes and character voice lines add story material about the series' figures.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted
summary: A VR game presented as Fazbear Entertainment's 'Freddy Fazbear Virtual Experience', recreating the earlier games while hidden tapes describe a corrupting presence in the game's code.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted - Curse of Dreadbear
summary: A Halloween DLC for Help Wanted adding new VR levels and characters such as Dreadbear within the virtual-experience framing.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery
summary: An augmented-reality mobile game in which Fazbear Entertainment's 'Fazbear Funtime Service' delivers animatronics to customers, with seasonal story events.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
summary: A boy trapped overnight in Freddy Fazbear's Mega Pizzaplex is helped by Glamrock Freddy while pursued by staff, animatronics and a rabbit-costumed figure.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
summary: A free story DLC in which Cassie explores the ruined Mega Pizzaplex after Security Breach, searching for Gregory.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2
summary: A VR sequel in which the player works through Fazbear Entertainment job simulations featuring characters from across the series, including the Mega Pizzaplex.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit
summary: A 2D adventure in which a boy, Oswald, travels through a ball pit at a rundown pizzeria into its past and brings something back.
settingYearLabel: Present day undated; the past era is 1985 (calendar seen in-game)

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
summary: A first-person game in which a Fazbear Entertainment employee explores Murray's costume facility and confronts the Mimic.
settingYearLabel: Undated here (a teaser trailer shows '1979'; in-game dates not verified by this research)

title: Freddy in Space 2
summary: A comedic side-scrolling shooter spin-off made to promote a St. Jude charity livestream.
